title: Problem-Framing Canvas
description: Separate the observed problem, affected customer, decision, and assumptions.

title: Assumption Mapper
description: Rank assumptions by importance and strength of available evidence.

title: Interview Builder
description: Prepare neutral customer discovery questions and an evidence log.

title: Competitor Matrix
description: Compare alternatives by customer, promise, price, and workflow.

title: Market Sizing Worksheet
description: Document a transparent bottom-up market estimate.

title: Pricing Experiment Designer
description: Define a test, outcome measure, stopping rule, and next decision.

title: Unit Economics Model
description: Connect acquisition, gross margin, retention, and customer value assumptions.

title: Cash Runway Calculator
description: Explore contribution, burn, break-even revenue, and cash runway.

title: Decision Memo
description: Present the decision, evidence, uncertainty, recommendation, and next experiment.

title: Sprint Quality Review
description: Review evidence quality, analytical integrity, usability, and scope discipline.
